d: The Spurs defeated the Kings, 123-107 tonight in Sacramento. Stephon Castle contributed a team-high 28 points to go with 11 assists 8 rebounds and 4 three pointers, with Julian Champagnie of the Spurs adding an additional 22 points (7-14 FG, 6-13 3P) in the game. Domantas Sabonis finished with a team-high 20 points along with 12 rebounds for the Kings in the losing effort. The Spurs improve their record to 15-3 with the win, while the Kings fall to 2-15 for the season.
